reviews.comment: Do not take if you are a male. I won't over explain, but I wish A&M would investigate this professor. Heavy grading bias without clear explanation of what she wants to hear. Schloss took weeks to a month to receive a grade. By that time I was already 2 "PCA's" deep. Schloss pushes her anxiety, depression and bias onto her students. History is Sad.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: One thing that disturbed me is she gave me the wrong grade. When I asked if it was correct she pressed he chest area into my back shoulder. I believe it was intentional.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures and reading discussions were almost two-thirds filler words; she went on random tangents half the time, and she refused to give any meaningful writing tips or critique besides the occasional note on "passive voice" and "connect this to your broader topic." Wonderful person, horrible professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of the best history teachers, I went to every class for 406, awesome lectures and a lot of cool stuff to read. She grades fairly yet also critically, but show up, read what you need to, and actually use your brain and you might make an A. 406 was the hardest yet best course I've ever taken, and I'm excited to take her 320 class next semester.

This class was amazing. While we did spend a good chunk of the class talking about Saint Domingue, it was good content in context with what was happening in metropolitan France at the time. She is willing to help and work with you. There were so many times she just sat with me and listened. I am taking her again for 320 next semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Schloss is a great professor! She is very passionate about history and it shows in her lectures. She cares about her students and she will do whatever she to help them. The assignments are easy and it is necessary to retain the contents of the reading assignments but most of the books are interesting so its not that hard to finish them.

Dr. Schloss is a very nice person and is very knowledgeable about the topic at hand. It is clear that Dr. Schloss knows the course information, but it is difficult to understand it, especially when applying it to the tests. Dr. Schloss is very patient and open to questions. There are two difficult tests and 3 essays over important historical books.

Original prof had to leave for the semester, so we got Dr. Schloss. She's a lovely person and a somewhat decent lecturer, however, there are only 3 essays and 2 exams which grades are based on. The exam "review sheet" is a list of vocab terms that are completely unhelpful in reviewing material. Your grade will drop a letter if you miss > 4 classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had Dr. Schloss unexpectedly for History 102 as the original professor had to leave with no explanation. We had 3 writing assignments which were 15% of our grade and 2 exams which were 30%. Even after attending all of her lectures and studying all material provided I was not able to achieve the grade I wanted. Very difficult to study for.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The KINDEST woman to have ever existed. I had her for HIST 481 which is an excellent topic. She is a great professor and will help you grow as a history major. She is so lovely and I would recommend her to anyone and everyone. She made my college experience so much better just because she was kind.

Dr. Schloss is seriously my favorite professor at A&M! She really cares for her students and wants them to succeed. I asked her tons of questions both in person and over email and she was always very helpful and available. This class does require a lot of reading and writing, but it is a writing-intensive class so what can you expect. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I am taking a class next semester almost entirely because of the fact that it is being taught by Dr. Schloss.  She is an amazing lecturer; I learned so much just within a few weeks of being in her class.  Some might claim she is a hard grader, but she is always fair and she can tell when students have put in effort.

She wasn't really clear on what she wants in terms of the papers you write (2 book reports, and 2 written tests). Was kinda a pain to get an A, but you'll definitely pass if you just show up and she recognizes you (participation is 15%). Honestly got an A cause of covid since she gave us a week to write our finals (2 essays).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Being one of the very few history majors in this class, the class took a completely different approach compared to a normal history class. I did not expect this because it is a 400 level history class, but after taking this class, Dr. Schloss has geared it heavily towards the large presence of education majors that take it. This wasn't a bad class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Schloss for two history classes in the same semester. She is extremely caring, knowledgable, nice, and makes sure her students understand the content. Her classes typically require 3 - 4 papers and a midterm and final. She works with students schedules and helps with anything after class or in office hours. I highly recommend her!

Dr. Schloss is a awesome professor who genuinely cares about her students! Took her Hist 280 class and really enjoyed it. The class is writing intensive and requires time and effort. However, if you put in the work and go to her office hours she will work with you! Great teacher, very personable and has a great sense of humor! Take Dr. Schloss!!!!!
Great professor. Not an easy A but the best classes rarely are. Learned a lot (both in history and how to write effectively). I only wish she taught a wider variety of classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr Schloss is a superior professor with a talent for telling a story.  I enjoyed attending class and looked forward to the next one so I could find out more about the politics and intrigue of the French Revolution.  She's a fair grader and empathetic to issues in the lives of her students.  If you need an upper level history course, TAKE THIS ONE!
Dr. Schools was an AMAZING professor. She was always very energetic and interested in the material being taught, which made it way easier for me to learn. Take her take her take her!
Very helpful. Did a good job of covering the French Revolution period both at home in France and in the French colony of St.-Domingue (modern Haiti). Excellent use of visual teaching aids.
